resources.string: This is what the shortcut alert looks like
“Try it” also sends you such an offer as a notification.

For one trip: allows sprint changes and switches the shortcut alert on from 1 minute. You switch it on with the chip “Every minute counts” at a connection or in the live trip – mainly useful when the alert is not always on.
This mark on a ride shows the sunny side. Tap it to open this explanation again.
